updates.label: Agent
updates.new_description: A class representing an agent that is responsible for carrying out a process, producing data, or contributing to the provenance of a resource in H2KG.

updates.label: Data
updates.new_description: A class representing data produced, used, or referenced by a process or measurement in H2KG.

updates.label: Data Point
updates.new_description: A class representing a single data point that links a value to the property and measurement context it belongs to in H2KG.

updates.label: Instrument
updates.new_description: A class representing an instrument used to perform, support, or control a measurement or manufacturing process in H2KG.

updates.label: Manufacturing
updates.new_description: A class representing a manufacturing process that prepares, assembles, coats, or otherwise fabricates a material or device in H2KG.

updates.label: Matter
updates.new_description: A class representing a material entity that participates in a process, measurement, or device configuration in H2KG.

updates.label: Measurement
updates.new_description: A class representing a measurement process that determines one or more properties of a material, device, or system in H2KG.

updates.label: Metadata
updates.new_description: A class representing metadata used to describe the provenance, identity, structure, or context of another resource in H2KG.

updates.label: Parameter
updates.new_description: A class representing a parameter specified as an input, setting, or condition for a process or measurement in H2KG.

updates.label: Process
updates.new_description: A class representing a process that transforms material, produces data, or changes the state of a system in H2KG.

updates.label: Property
updates.new_description: A class representing a property that can be measured, computed, or otherwise assigned to a material, process, or system in H2KG.

updates.label: Unit
updates.new_description: A class representing a unit used to express the value of a quantity in H2KG.

updates.label: hasIdentifier
updates.new_description: A datatype property relating a resource to a literal identifier used to distinguish or reference it.

updates.label: atCurrentDensity
updates.new_description: An object property relating a data point to the current-density value at which it is reported.

updates.label: fromMeasurement
updates.new_description: An object property relating a data point to the measurement from which it was generated.

updates.label: hasInputData
updates.new_description: An object property relating a process or measurement to data used as an input.

updates.label: hasInputMaterial
updates.new_description: An object property relating a process or measurement to a material entity that serves as an input.

updates.label: hasOutputData
updates.new_description: An object property relating a measurement or process to data generated as an output.

updates.label: hasOutputMaterial
updates.new_description: An object property relating a process to a material entity produced as an output.

updates.label: hasParameter
updates.new_description: An object property relating a process or measurement to a parameter that specifies one of its inputs, settings, or operating conditions.

updates.label: hasPart
updates.new_description: An object property relating an entity or process to a constituent part.

updates.label: hasProperty
updates.new_description: An object property relating a measurement to a property that is determined, reported, or otherwise associated with that measurement.

updates.label: hasQuantityValue
updates.new_description: An object property relating a parameter, property, or data point to the quantity value that expresses it.

updates.label: hasSubProcess
updates.new_description: An object property relating a process to a subprocess that forms part of its overall execution.

updates.label: isPartOf
updates.new_description: An object property relating an entity or process to a larger entity or process of which it forms a part.

updates.label: isSubProcessOf
updates.new_description: An object property relating a subprocess to the larger process of which it forms a part.

updates.label: measures
updates.new_description: An object property relating a measurement to a property that it determines.

updates.label: normalizedTo
updates.new_description: An object property relating a property or result to the basis used for its normalization.

updates.label: ofProperty
updates.new_description: An object property relating a data point to the property represented by that data point.

updates.label: referenceElectrode
updates.new_description: An object property relating an electrochemical measurement setup or process to the reference electrode it uses.

updates.label: usesInstrument
updates.new_description: An object property relating a process or measurement to an instrument used to carry it out or support it.
